comparisonNote: Numerical parity with commercial PROKON (or any other commercial solver) is UNKNOWN unless independent licensed comparisons exist.

supportedDomain.summary: Linear, small-displacement 3D Euler–Bernoulli prismatic frames with isotropic materials, SI engineering storage, nodal and member loads, explicit combinations, elastic fibre stress screening (mechanics-v1). Elastic flexural buckling factors and linearised P-Δ-δ second-order analysis of one case or combination (stability-v1).

excludedDomains: response spectrum, time-history and harmonic analysis

capabilities.scopeKey: eulerBernoulli3D / isotropic / prismatic / SI
limitations: Axial/shear/torsion releases rejected; My/Mz end releases only
No shear deformation; buckling and second-order effects are the separate stability-v1 analysis types
Memory guard may refuse large models under tight budgets

capabilities.scopeKey: M02 / UDL / self-weight / point loads / My-Mz releases / combinations / envelopes
limitations: Envelope extrema are per-scalar with governing provenance, not a simultaneous force set

capabilities.scopeKey: M03 / CopyBay / dual Workers / 5k capacity / section axis / hierarchy
limitations: OpenSees pack covers S01/S02/B07; R01/B09 native-only per ADR 0006

capabilities.scopeKey: M04 / IndexedDB / SW cache / migrate 0.9→1.0 / crash-quota matrix
limitations: Unknown major schemas are refused; originals retained on migration

capabilities.scopeKey: M05 / solid-rectangle calculator / variants / portal templates
limitations: Only solidRectangle section computation; custom J or documented rectangle torsion estimate

capabilities.scopeKey: M22 / JSON-pointer variant sweeps / linear static / native CLI and browser on one core
limitations: Restricted declarative JSON-pointer sweeps; no general scripting language or Python runtime
Linear static analysis of one case or combination per study
At most 50 variants, 100 steps per variant and 1000 steps per study; the run shares the project's analysis time limit
Multilingual reports are deferred

capabilities.scopeKey: M06 / mechanics-v1 fibre stress / non-code disclaimer
limitations: Elastic longitudinal fibre stress only — not member stability or building-code compliance

capabilities.scopeKey: stability-v1 / consistent flexural K_G / subspace iteration with Sturm check
limitations: A critical factor is an elastic load multiplier of the idealised model, not a member resistance, effective length or code verdict
Flexural instability only: torsional, flexural-torsional and lateral-torsional modes are excluded
My/Mz member end releases are independent hinge DOFs
One real load case or combination; envelopes are not valid inputs

capabilities.scopeKey: stability-v1 / linearised P-Δ-δ / Picard iteration / explicit imperfection
limitations: Small rotations about the undeformed geometry; large-displacement response is excluded
Proportional loading only; no construction staging
Loads at or beyond the elastic critical state fail with no response
Flexural instability only: torsional, flexural-torsional and lateral-torsional modes are excluded
My/Mz member end releases are independent hinge DOFs
One real load case or combination; envelopes are not valid inputs

capabilities.scopeKey: dynamics-v1 / declared mass sources / consistent or lumped mass / subspace iteration with Sturm check
limitations: Undamped free vibration about the unstressed geometry; no damping, geometric stiffness or soil-structure interaction
Euler-Bernoulli members: rotary inertia of sections is neglected
Participation is reported for global translations only
Mass is declared (self mass, load-case gravity loads / g, nodal masses), never implied
Rigid-body modes are refused, not computed; My/Mz member end releases are independent hinge DOFs
A frequency or participation ratio is not a floor-vibration, comfort or code serviceability verdict

capabilities.scopeKey: M15 numerical family / response-v1 / steady-state harmonic response with Rayleigh damping / direct complex solve
limitations: Beyond the analysis MVP (whose SPEC exclusions still list response spectrum, time-history and harmonic analysis); time-history analysis remains excluded
One load case or combination applied in phase as F cos(Ωt); Rayleigh damping with a₁ > 0
Complex displacements and support reactions per frequency; member actions are not reported
Not a vibration serviceability or comfort check

capabilities.scopeKey: M15 numerical family / response-v1 / user spectrum, one direction, SRSS or CQC modal combination
limitations: The spectrum is the engineer's table (T, Sa); no code spectrum, behaviour factor or accidental torsion is supplied
One direction per run; directional combination is not provided
Combined values are peak magnitudes (signs and simultaneity lost); no missing-mass correction
Not a seismic code check; the M15 parent is not accepted

capabilities.scopeKey: M21 / exchange-v1 / IFC4 structural analysis model and DXF wireframe import and export with a conversion review, mapping manifests and loss ledgers
limitations: IFC4 (ISO 16739-1:2018) IfcStructuralAnalysisModel only; IFC2X3 and IFC4X3 are refused by name
Frame items only: surface members, curve and surface connections, varying or curved members, eccentric connections, composite or tapered profile sets are refused or skipped by explicit decision
DXF is geometry: every analysis property comes from explicit per-layer decisions; DXF export is R12 with $INSUNITS
Nothing undefined is assumed: unassigned units, elastic or unset conditions, unknown combination purposes and skipped content are decisions; batch imports need a mapping manifest
Support settlements, design data, mass sources, response spectra and results are not exported to IFC (listed in the export ledger)
Browser-only file exchange; no native Revit, Tekla or analysis-program adapter and no Prodesk equivalence

capabilities.scopeKey: WebGPU / orthographic 3D / GPU ID / Rust screen picking
limitations: Laboratory macOS Metal Tier A accepted per ADR 0005; optional Windows/Linux matrix later
WebGPU f32 is display-only; engineering truth remains f64

capabilities.scopeKey: M01 / portal / working planes / topology / snap
limitations: Connect intersections limited to nonparallel XZ members within documented counts

capabilities.scopeKey: M07 / aisc-360-22-lrfd S2 + S3 flexure
limitations: AISC 360-22 LRFD S2 enabled after resources.lock + fixture corpus verification
S2 covers classification, tension, compression E3, flexure F2, shear G2.1, H1

S3 flexure: flange local buckling of noncompact flanges (F3-1) and lateral-torsional buckling (F2.2) with user Lb and Cb, fixtures F.1-2B, F.1-3B, F.3B; Cb is user input or derived by F1-1 per unbraced segment, with bracing points along a member giving each segment its own Lb and Cb (Cb = 1 at a free cantilever end)
Serviceability: a user deflection criterion L/n under one service case or combination (chord or absolute basis), reported separately from strength; not an AISC 360 requirement (ADR 0020)
Slender flanges (F3-2), noncompact/slender webs (F4/F5), HSS, torsion, weak-axis flexure and non-prismatic members return unsupported; H1 is formula-checked with published φ capacities
Not a claim of commercial PROKON parity or professional code certification

capabilities.scopeKey: M10 numerical family / plate-v1 / flat rectangular slab panel with one opening / Q4 membrane + MITC4
limitations: Flat rectangular panels with at most one rectangular opening, uniform downward pressure, linear elastic isotropic material, free/simple (hard)/clamped edges; general and curved shells remain excluded
Not connected to the frame model: no frame–slab coupling, column point supports, cracking or long-term effects
Unsmoothed element-centre actions are the design values; smoothed values are display only; the convergence indicator is not a proof and stays high at re-entrant opening corners

Wood–Armer moments are moments to resist, not reinforcement; reinforcement areas, punching, detailing and deflection limits need the slab code profile (M08 resources) and are UNSUPPORTED; M10 is not accepted

capabilities.scopeKey: M12 / rc-column biaxial section + ec2-uk-na column checks (demonstration)
limitations: EC2 column checks are a demonstration of EN 1992-1-1:2004 incl. AC:2008/AC:2010 with UK NA incl. Amd 1 (2009); A1:2014 and NA+A2:2014 not reconciled; not a certified design (ADR 0027)
Solid rectangular sections with perimeter bars and one perimeter link; exact biaxial resistance M_Rd(N, θ) from strain compatibility, never the (5.39) interpolation
Slenderness by (5.15)/(5.16) from the engineer's end restraints; imperfections (5.2), nominal curvature (5.8.8) and minimum eccentricity (6.1(4)), the imperfection in one direction at a time
Shear with σ_cp, 9.5.2/9.5.3 detailing, cover and spacing; least-steel reinforcement proposal
Circular sections, nominal stiffness method, global second order (5.8.3.3), walls, laps and fck > 50 MPa are unsupported
Not a claim of commercial PROKON parity or professional code certification

capabilities.scopeKey: M08 / M11 / M12 / ec2-uk-na / rectangular RC beams, columns and pad footings: EN 1992-1-1:2004 incl. AC:2008/AC:2010, UK NA incl. Amd 1 (2009), demonstration
limitations: Demonstration, not a certified design: every run names the edition used; EN 1992-1-1:2004/A1:2014 and UK NA + A2:2014 are not held and not reconciled (ADR 0026)

Rectangular RC beams with vertical links at the governing sagging, hogging and shear key stations of one bound case or combination: flexure (6.1), shear (6.2.2/6.2.3), As,min/As,max and link limits (9.2.1.1, 9.2.2), cover (4.4.1), bar spacing (8.2), anchorage length (8.4), minimum crack steel (7.3.2), crack control by Tables 7.2N/7.3N (7.3.3) and span/depth deflection (7.4.2)

Exposure, c_min,dur (BS 8500), aggregate, structural system, partitions and the quasi-permanent combination are the engineer's inputs; a check lacking one is INDETERMINATE, and anchorage passes only on the engineer's confirmation

Reinforcement proposal: least steel mass per metre over discrete bars and links for which no check fails; schedule of straight bars and closed links is indicative, not a fabrication schedule (no BS 8666 shape codes, curtailment or laps)
Redistribution (5.5), direct crack-width and deflection calculation (7.3.4, 7.4.3), torsion, axial force, flanged sections and fck > 50 MPa are unsupported
Not a claim of commercial PROKON parity or professional code certification

capabilities.scopeKey: M11 / rigid pad on tensionless ground + ec2-uk-na pad footing design (demonstration)
limitations: EC2 footing design is a demonstration of EN 1992-1-1:2004 incl. AC:2008/AC:2010 with UK NA incl. Amd 1 (2009); A1:2014 and NA+A2:2014 not reconciled; not a certified design (ADR 0028)
Rectangular pad with a concentric rectangular column; rigid base on linear tensionless ground; no downward force or a resultant off the base is refused
Allowable bearing pressure is the engineer's input; no ground resistance or settlement is computed (EN 1997 not held)
Bottom bars sized for face bending, the 9.8.2.2 tie force and A_s,min with straight anchorage; one-way shear, punching (6.4.4(2)) and the face check
Eccentric columns, stepped or sloped bases, uplift top steel, punching reinforcement, pile caps and combined footings are unsupported
Not a claim of commercial PROKON parity or professional code certification
Outside analysis MVP; see PARITY_ROADMAP.md
The M10 plate-v1, M12 rc-column and M15 response-v1 numerical families are listed separately; their code checks remain outside
